sv.title: Jättedepå ska lösa järnvägens dolda flaskhals
sv.summary: SJ och Jernhusen pumpar just nu in miljarder i det svenska järnvägssystemet för att lösa olika flaskhalsar. Inom kort flyttar tågbolaget in i vad som blir norra Europas största tågdepå. Men trots miljardregnet räcker kapaciteten inte till.

en.title: Giant depot to solve the railway's hidden bottleneck
en.summary: SJ and Jernhusen are currently pumping billions into the Swedish railway system to resolve various bottlenecks. Shortly, the train operator will move into what will become the largest train depot in Northern Europe. But despite the billions, the capacity is still not enough.

sv.title: Elchocken tvingar krögarparet att stänga – hela vintern
sv.summary: De höga elpriserna slår hårt mot södra Sverige. På gästgiveriet i Skivarp har Jeanette och Johan Bohman nu fattat ett tungt beslut: Att hålla restaurangköket stängt under vintern. – Det är vårt kök som drar enorma mängder el.

en.title: Electricity shock forces restaurant couple to close – for the entire winter
en.summary: High electricity prices are hitting southern Sweden hard. At the Skivarp coaching inn, Jeanette and Johan Bohman have made a difficult decision: to keep the restaurant kitchen closed during the winter. – It is our kitchen that draws enormous amounts of electricity.

sv.title: Nattsäsong är årets skönlitterära bok

en.title: Nattsäsong is the year's best fiction book

en.title: Relief and criticism after Nvidia's U-turn
en.summary: NEW YORK. Jensen Huang's return sends Nvidia shares rushing higher. Donald Trump takes credit for the decision, which several analysts see as commercially necessary. But the board's U-turn also raises questions about how the AI giant is governed and how risks are to be monitored.
